name: Inspired by Franky Rizardo
description: Dutch house and tech house DJ (Music On, ANTS, elrow, FLOW, LTF Records). Groove-first, sparkly tech house with deeper detours that return to the groove. Driving, danceable, high-energy club sets.
notes: Recent LTF releases sit at 128-129 BPM (Zero Azucar 129, Shinjuku 129, Love Me Right 128). Keep the groove locked, allow short deeper dips of 1-2 energy points, then return to driving tech house.
